login.login-subtitle: Welcome back! Please enter your credentials or proceed with a third party authentication.
login.right-panel-answer: Our mission is to make document-scanning, editing and archiving easy and approachable for people of all ages and backgrounds. Using innovative AI technology, we deliver quality and performance, all within one fully-integrated platform.
login.faulty-login-message: An error has occurred during the log-in process. Please contact an administrator.

homepage.truthy-create-user-details: The user was successfully created. You may now see the new user you have added in the main User list.
homepage.truthy-create-department-details: The department was successfully created. You may now see the new user you have added in the main Department list.
homepage.truthy-edit-user-details: The user was successfully edited. You may now see the user you have edited in the main User list.
homepage.truthy-edit-department-details: The department was successfully edited. You may now see the department you have edited in the main Department list.
homepage.faulty-get-users-details: An unexpected error occurred during the retrieval of the user list. Please contact an administrator.
homepage.truthy-delete-user-details: The user was successfully deleted. You won't see their data anymore in the main User list.
homepage.faulty-delete-user-details: An unexpected error occurred during the removal of the user. Please contact an administrator.
homepage.delete-user-confirm-dialog-message: Are you sure you want to delete this user? This action is irreversible.
homepage.truthy-delete-department-details: The department was successfully deleted. You won't see its data anymore in the main Department list.
homepage.faulty-delete-department-details: An unexpected error occurred during the removal of the department. Please contact an administrator.
homepage.delete-department-confirm-dialog-message: Are you sure you want to delete this department? This action is irreversible.

edit-popup.name: First Name
edit-popup.description: This dialog displays details for the selected user. To modify the information, edit the fields directly. Please note that changes are not saved automatically; click 'Update' to apply your edits. You can cancel at any time by clicking 'Discard' or the 'X' in the corner.
edit-popup.faulty-edit-details: An unexpected error occurred during the modification of the new user. Please contact an administrator.

create-popup.title: Create a new user
create-popup.name: First Name
create-popup.description: This dialog allows you to create a new record. Please fill in the required fields to define the profile. Note that the entry will only be created once you click 'Create'; closing the window or clicking 'Discard' will erase all input data.
create-popup.faulty-create-details: An unexpected error occurred during the creation of the new user. Please contact an administrator.

create-department-popup.title: Create a new department
create-department-popup.subtitle: This dialog allows you to create a new record. Please fill in the required fields to define the department. Note that the entry will only be created once you click 'Create'; closing the window or clicking 'Discard' will erase all input data.
create-department-popup.name: Department Name
create-department-popup.faulty-create-details: An unexpected error occurred during the creation of the new department. Please contact an administrator.

edit-department-popup.subtitle: This dialog displays details for the selected department. To modify the information, edit the fields directly. Please note that changes are not saved automatically; click 'Update' to apply your edits. You can cancel at any time by clicking 'Discard' or the 'X' in the corner.
edit-department-popup.name: Department Name
edit-department-popup.faulty-edit-details: An unexpected error occurred during the modification of the new department. Please contact an administrator.
